Plot saved residual PCA

Source: R/api-plotting-dispatch.R
plot.mfrm_residual_pca.Rd

Display a saved residual PCA or its saved parallel-analysis comparison. Plotting does not generate a new parallel reference.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_residual_pca'
plot(x, type = "scree", mode = "overall", ...)

Arguments

x

A result from analyze_residual_pca().

type

"scree", "parallel_scree", "parallel_excess", or "loadings". Existing "overall_*" and "facet_*" spellings remain supported.

mode

"overall" (default) or "facet". Do not also supply mode when using a prefixed type such as "facet_scree".

...

facet selects a facet for mode = "facet" (default: the first available facet); component = 1 selects a loading component; top_n = 20 limits displayed loadings. preset is "standard", "publication", "compact", or "monochrome"; draw = FALSE returns data without drawing.

Value

A named list of plotting data (class mfrm_plot_data) with:

  • plot: "scree", "parallel_scree", "parallel_excess", or "loadings"

  • mode: "overall" or "facet"

  • facet: facet name (or NULL)

  • title: plot title text

  • data: underlying table used for plotting

  • InferenceTier, SupportsFormalInference, PrimaryReportingEligible, ReportingUse, and DecisionUse: machine-readable exploratory-screening guards

Interpretation

  • "scree" shows component eigenvalues. A dominant early component is exploratory evidence of residual structure, not a standalone test of unidimensionality.

  • "parallel_scree" shows the observed eigenvalues and saved reference mean/cutoff; "parallel_excess" shows the observed-minus-cutoff difference. Compute these references with parallel = TRUE in analyze_residual_pca() first. Exceeding a cutoff suggests follow-up, not proof of multidimensionality. Inspect parallel_status and bootstrap_trials for unavailable comparisons and distinguish residual permutation from refitted model bootstrap.

  • "loadings" shows the largest absolute loadings; inspect both signs and magnitudes to identify the contributing variables or elements.

Use overall mode before locating patterns within individual facets. Repeated plots of a saved result reuse the same PCA and do not provide independent evidence.

See also

analyze_residual_pca(), mfrmr_plot_migration

Examples

ratings_all <- load_mfrmr_data("example_core")
selected_people <- unique(ratings_all$Person)[1:24]
ratings <- ratings_all[
  ratings_all$Person %in% selected_people, , drop = FALSE]
fit <- fit_mfrm(ratings, "Person", c("Rater", "Criterion"), "Score",
                method = "JML")
diag <- diagnose_mfrm(fit, residual_pca = "overall")
pca <- analyze_residual_pca(diag, mode = "overall")
plt <- plot(pca, type = "scree", draw = FALSE)
head(plt$data)
#> $plot
#> [1] "scree"
#> 
#> $mode
#> [1] "overall"
#> 
#> $facet
#> NULL
#> 
#> $title
#> [1] "Overall Residual PCA (Scree)"
#> 
#> $subtitle
#> [1] "Variance explained by residual components"
#> 
#> $legend
#>                                     label      role  aesthetic   value
#> 1                    Residual eigenvalues component line-point #1f78b4
#> 2 Unit eigenvalue (descriptive reference) reference       line #6b7280
#> 
# Ten replicates illustrate the display, not a stable reference cutoff.
pca_pa <- analyze_residual_pca(diag, mode = "overall", parallel = TRUE,
                               parallel_reps = 10, seed = 2026)
pa <- plot(pca_pa, type = "parallel_scree", draw = FALSE)
head(pa$data)
#> $plot
#> [1] "parallel_scree"
#> 
#> $mode
#> [1] "overall"
#> 
#> $facet
#> NULL
#> 
#> $title
#> [1] "Overall Residual PCA (Parallel Scree)"
#> 
#> $subtitle
#> [1] "Conditional permutation reference; fitted-model uncertainty omitted.\nComponentwise cutoffs; no adjustment for scanning components"
#> 
#> $legend
#>                                     label            role  aesthetic   value
#> 1           Observed residual eigenvalues       component line-point #1f78b4
#> 2         95% residual-permutation cutoff parallel_cutoff line-point #d95f02
#> 3                           Parallel mean   parallel_mean       line #1b9e77
#> 4 Unit eigenvalue (descriptive reference)       reference       line #6b7280
#> 
plt_load <- plot(pca, type = "loadings", component = 1, draw = FALSE)
head(plt_load$data)
#> $plot
#> [1] "loadings"
#> 
#> $mode
#> [1] "overall"
#> 
#> $facet
#> NULL
#> 
#> $title
#> [1] "Overall Residual PCA (Loadings: PC1)"
#> 
#> $subtitle
#> [1] "Top 16 absolute loadings"
#> 
#> $legend
#>               label    role aesthetic   value
#> 1 Positive loadings loading       bar #1b9e77
#> 2 Negative loadings loading       bar #d95f02
#> 
if (interactive()) {
  plot(pca, type = "scree", preset = "publication")
}
